]> 13/08/2026 7:09 Another 5cm and a clear day ahead.

We had another 5cm of fresh snow overnight and are in for some clearer days ahead now that the storm has rolled through. The forecast is calling for a partly cloudy day, but the sky is clear this morning and you can't spot any of those clouds! It's currently hovering just below 0 degrees and we're headed for a top of 4 degrees.

With the variable conditions of the past few days, we've lost a couple of lifts: Piper and Burke T-Bars in Smiggins have closed for now. We still have 39 lifts set to spin and 58 groomed runs across the resort, giving you plenty of room to explore.

Around the resort today, we have live music at Blue Cow Bistro from 1pm and at Jax Bar from 12pm.

For our park riders, please note that the Front Valley park will be light on features today (and maybe tomorrow) as we rebuild for Val's Blue Steel Rail Jam presented by Oakley this Sunday, an event not to miss.

Looking ahead, we're building to a big weekend of live music and events, with Red Bull Sessions, Subaru Scavenger Hunts, and our Sunrise Sessions at Blue Cow kicking off tomorrow morning (quick, there's only a couple of spots left). With great weather on the forecast, it's a weekend not to miss.
